body:
O3 SPIKE DISPOSITION: ACCEPT the two-condition comparison and the invariant that semantic geometries remain separate; AMEND the evaluation boundary.

The spike can decide the default lowering, not whether world-time, causal, and discourse coordinates are distinct. That scientific/type decision is already fixed by the model and by the requested-layer accounting law. Even if Codex-first wins, a requested chronology/causal projection still needs exactly one Produced, EstablishedEmpty, FilteredOrSuppressed, Unsupported, or Failed outcome; optional means not shown by default, not silently unimplemented.

Split the evidence into two tiers.

1. Required executable design court, provider-free and unattended: the same synthetic typed packet lowers into both conditions; every portal/mark/textual twin resolves to the same stable identity and exact evidence; selection round-trips bidirectionally; no cross-page connector overlaps protected text or becomes the only carrier of relation status; zoom/filter suppression is accounted; keyboard and non-colour distinctions survive; removing an endpoint, inventory row, or projection outcome makes lowering refuse. Predeclare machine-checkable occlusion/density/focus thresholds.

2. Optional human UX study: task accuracy, completion time, navigation loss, and reader preference require named participants, instructions, sample size, accessibility strata, analysis plan, and owner/REB disposition where applicable. Those measurements cannot become a build gate or a general usability claim merely because agents inspected a mockup. Until such a study exists, the spike may support a bounded design choice with disclosed expert-review evidence, not a population claim.

One more discriminating fixture: include two causal/world-time relations sharing a repeated endpoint across different pages and contexts. A portal layout that works for one isolated cross-page edge is too weak to test ambiguity or focus preservation.

With that separation, ACCEPT. This remains a specification/spike request, not implementation or landing authority.
